b: I (22 f) have had trouble sleeping for years. There are periods of time where my sleep is relatively normal (seven-five hours of uninterrupted sleep) but other times it’s a mess.

For certain periods of time usually one to two months, I have trouble sleeping and staying asleep. I have tried most things, weighted blankets, no night lights, cutting caffeine out of my diet, herbal tea, melatonin gummies. I have even tried asmr.
No matter what I do I can’t stay asleep and I wake up every few hours. I always wake up completely exhausted and I have intense brain fog and migraines.
I am pretty sure that this isn’t psychological or induced by anxiety, however when I have trouble sleeping I get easily irritated and my productivity also worsens.
I would appreciate any tips on supplements or doctors tests that could help me with this so please give me any suggestions.

P.S. I am not planning on taking melatonin again because one it didn’t work for me and two I got night terrors that made me extremely paranoid. I would also prefer natural remedies or suggestions like sleeping masks because I would rather not take sleeping pills.
